subject: VPN stops connecting after password change
description_at_creation: I changed my password yesterday evening and since then the VPN client fails with 'authentication failed'. Web login to the intranet works fine. Just me as far as I know.

subject: Locked out again this morning
description_at_creation: My account locked out again. This is the third time this week. It gets unlocked and then locks again by lunchtime. I have a work phone and a laptop.

subject: URGENT!!! nothing works
description_at_creation: nothing is working this morning, please fix asap

_gold._note: Expected behaviour: needs_information. No category, no priority. Tone is not evidence of impact.

subject: Need Figma installed and also my mailbox is full
description_at_creation: Could someone install Figma on my laptop please. Separately my mailbox keeps saying it is full and I cannot send anything.

_gold._note: Two unrelated issues in one ticket. Expected behaviour: abstain and ask for a split, not pick one at random.

subject: How do I claim back my train fare?
description_at_creation: I travelled to the Manchester site last week and want to claim the ticket cost. Who do I send the receipt to?

_gold._note: Genuinely outside all four categories and outside the corpus. Expected behaviour: no_answer. This is the kind of case that makes the correct-refusal metric meaningful.
